integrity: The orbit relation was checked directly to be countable Borel; the recent hyperfiniteness input was independently cross-checked; and the Dougherty--Jackson--Kechris automorphism realization, upper reduction, and Glimm--Effros lower reduction were verified separately.
scientific_limitations: The result is a Borel-reducibility classification, not a structural classification of the actions.
The proof combines a recent hyperfiniteness theorem with classical general classification theorems; it is not a new hyperfiniteness proof.
No claim is made for noncommutative monoids, infinite-fiber actions, or finer reducibility notions.
title: Single-automorphism compression of bounded-to-one commutative monoid orbits
